name: De Vulgari Eloquentia: Deluxe Edition

categories.label: Final Election status
categories.hint: 0 none; 1 Banker (Merchant, 7 votes) 6 VP; 2 Monk (Friar, 10 votes) 11 VP; 3 Camerlengo (Cardinal, 11 votes) 14 VP; 4 Pope (Cardinal, 17 votes, only one) 22 VP.

categories.label: Highest total remaining cube value
categories.labelVi: Tổng giá trị cube còn lại cao nhất
categories.hint: Yes for the player with the highest remaining cube sum after the election (tie: furthest on Knowledge track): 3 VP.

categories.label: Turquoise cubes (Scribes) behind screen
categories.hint: 1 VP each; only cubes behind the screen.

categories.label: Papal Library tiles
categories.hint: Sum of VP shown on your revealed Papal Library tiles.

categories.label: Most Ducati
categories.hint: 0 = no; 6 VP if the richest player is a Merchant, 3 VP if Friar or Cardinal (tie: furthest on Knowledge track).

categories.label: Riddle from Verona (furthest player)
categories.hint: Only the furthest player: 4, 5 or 6 VP by space reached or passed (tie: disc at bottom of stack). Others 0.

categories.label: Canticle of the Sun
categories.hint: Furthest player 9 VP, second furthest 6 VP (tie: disc at bottom of stack is further). Others 0.

categories.label: Messenger: cities with cultural value
categories.labelVi: Corriere: thành phố có giá trị văn hóa
categories.hint: Only if Messenger track completed and disc on Bologna: 1 VP per visited city with a cultural value (disc placed), Bologna included.

categories.label: Orient: harbor cities visited
categories.hint: Only Merchants who completed the Orient track: 1 VP per harbor city with your disc.

categories.label: Manuscripts by level
categories.hint: Each manuscript = its level (1-4) in VP.

categories.label: Manuscripts in all 5 colors
categories.hint: 5 VP once (level 4 counts as one of its colors; Papal tile with wild symbol counts as any color).

categories.label: Friar / Cardinal tile VP
categories.hint: Raffaele +4, Gigi -4, Lanzuisi +6 (0 if you became Pope), Shlasinger +4.

categories.label: Knowledge track position
categories.hint: Not VP. Tiebreaker only; leave disc where it is.

tiebreakers.description: Furthest on the Knowledge track; if on the same space, the player at the bottom of the stack wins.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends when the second red Papal Event tile is revealed (from turn 12); that turn is the last. Score order: Final Election first, then the Volgare Points list. Scoring happens only at game end (VP are called Volgare Points). Expansions (Ritmo Bellunese, Placiti di Capua, Guaita di Travale, Glossario cards) not modelled. richestDucati: enter 1 if the richest player is a Merchant, 2 if Friar/Cardinal, else 0.

sources.title: De Vulgari Eloquentia Deluxe English rulebook (Giochix.it)
